'''Tac-Comm control''' was the section of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Anchorhead Base]] responsible for granting clearance for departing vehicles. [[Turland Hack]] was on duty in Tac-Comm control when Anchorhead Base was [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|destroyed]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].
